A0188.title: Metaverse Identity Federation
A0188.description: Establishes a cross-platform, cross-virtual-world decentralized identity (DID) federation authentication system, achieving identity mutual recognition through verifiable credentials and cross-domain trust anchors, preventing user impersonation or credential replay across multiple metaverse platforms.
A0188.definition: Establish cross-platform decentralized identity (DID) authentication system to prevent impersonation.
A0188.limitation: DID methods and trust anchor implementations vary across platforms, leading to poor cross-domain mutual recognition consistency and potential verification loopholes that allow impersonation to bypass authentication; user private keys are stored in end-user wallets, and if phished or stolen by malicious clients, the federation authentication cannot distinguish the true operator; cross-platform credential replay detection relies on global state synchronization, where synchronization delays create replay windows; legacy platform account migration and credential inheritance mechanisms are weak, and account recovery processes can be exploited by social engineering to impersonate legitimate users.
